SELECT T1.Name, T1.Capacity
FROM stadium AS T1
JOIN concert AS T2
ON T1.Stadium_ID = T2.Stadium_ID
JOIN (
  SELECT Stadium_ID, AVG(Average) as Average
  FROM concert
  GROUP BY Stadium_ID
) AS T3
ON T1.Stadium_ID = T3.Stadium_ID AND T1.Average = T3.Average

SELECT 
  c.Continent, 
  AVG(LifeExpectancy) AS avg_life_expectancy, 
  SUM(Population) AS total_population
FROM 
  country c
  JOIN countrylanguage cl ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode
  JOIN city c2 ON c.Code = c2.CountryCode
WHERE 
  cl.IsOfficial = 'T' AND 
  LifeExpectancy < 72 AND 
  c.Continent IN (
    SELECT 
      Continent 
    FROM 
      country
    WHERE 
      LifeExpectancy < 72
  )
GROUP BY 
  c.Continent
